_doc: Baseline for tools/lint_tool_view.py (R-CAP1 CAP-4, DEC-43). Every site under systemu/ that writes a tool-list key (tools, available_tools, existing_tools, current_tool_catalog, tools_available, enabled_tools, more_tools) from something other than the selection view's .full_records(), with the exact count and why it may. Enforced both ways: an unlisted or over-count site fails, and a listed site that is gone or under its count fails until the entry is lowered/deleted -- this list only shrinks. kinds: not-a-prompt (never reaches an LLM prompt), inventory (an entity inventory, not a capability selection), candidate-gatherer (builds what the view then consumes), pass-through (forwards a value its caller filled from the view), names-roster (a names-only roster, already at index granularity).

sites.reason: The provider-native `tools` request parameter, forwarded verbatim. No production caller passes it (there is no llm_call(..., tools=...) site); a future caller must hand it view.full_records().
